# Base File 1: Building person-level dataset of ever-exiter school leaders, including time-invariant user data, position histories, and education histories. The goal is to predict which of these ever-exiters return to K-12 education at any point after exiting.

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r paths}
data_dir <- "/v5000/data/goldring_group/SampleFiles/Leader/0331"
leader_sample_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "Leader_Sample_raw_")
education_dir <- "/v5000/data/goldring_group/revelio_individual_user_education_us/"
user_dir <- "/v5000/data/goldring_group/revelio_individual_user_us/"
output_dir <- "/v5000/data/goldring_group/LPO7550/Sample"

sample_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = leader_sample_dir,
  pattern = "^Leader_Sample_raw__part_[0-9]{4}\\.parquet$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

education_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = education_dir,
pattern = "^individual_user_education_us__\\d+_\\d+_\\d+\\.parquet$",
full.names = TRUE
))

user_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = user_dir,
pattern = "^individual_user_us__\\d+_\\d+_\\d+\\.parquet$",
full.names = TRUE
))
```

```{r helpers and functions}
role_field_labels <- c(
  "11" = "Management Occupations",
  "13" = "Business and Financial Operations Occupations",
  "15" = "Computer and Mathematical Occupations",
  "17" = "Architecture and Engineering Occupations",
  "19" = "Life, Physical, and Social Science Occupations",
  "21" = "Community and Social Service Occupations",
  "23" = "Legal Occupations",
  "25" = "Educational Instruction and Library Occupations",
  "27" = "Arts, Design, Entertainment, Sports, and Media Occupations",
  "29" = "Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Occupations",
  "31" = "Healthcare Support Occupations",
  "33" = "Protective Service Occupations",
  "35" = "Food Preparation and Serving Related Occupations",
  "37" = "Building and Grounds Cleaning and Maintenance Occupations",
  "39" = "Personal Care and Service Occupations",
  "41" = "Sales and Related Occupations",
  "43" = "Office and Administrative Support Occupations",
  "45" = "Farming, Fishing, and Forestry Occupations",
  "47" = "Construction and Extraction Occupations",
  "49" = "Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Occupations",
  "51" = "Production Occupations",
  "53" = "Transportation and Material Moving Occupations",
  "55" = "Military Specific Occupations"
)

label_role_field <- function(x) {
  out <- unname(role_field_labels[as.character(as.integer(x))])
  out[is.na(out) & !is.na(x)] <- paste0("Field ", as.integer(x[is.na(out) & !is.na(x)]))
  out
}

# Function to pull all variables of one type from wide the data into one vector
extract_wide_values <- function(data, prefix) {
  data %>%
    select(matches(paste0("^", prefix, "_[0-9]+$"))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "source_col",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    pull(value)
}

# Function to count position_ids after wide
count_unique_wide <- function(data, prefix) {
  vals <- extract_wide_values(data, prefix) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    trimws()
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & vals != ""]
  length(unique(vals))
}

# Function to tally date missingness after wide
count_value_wide <- function(data, prefix, target) {
  vals <- extract_wide_values(data, prefix)

  sum(vals %in% target, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Function to count returners (and verify exiters) after wide
count_users_any_wide <- function(data, prefix, target) {
  wide_cols <- data %>%
    select(user_id, matches(paste0("^", prefix, "_[0-9]+$")))

  wide_cols %>%
    mutate(
      any_match = if_any(
        -user_id,
        ~ .x %in% target
      )
    ) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(any_match, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(n)
}
```

```{r read position data}
read_pos_cols <- c(
  "user_id", "position_id", "mapped_role",
  "startdate_parsed", "enddate_effective", "date_calc_valid_flag",
  "Education_role", "Teacher_role", "School_leader_soc_role",
  "EverEntrant", "EverExiter", "Returner", "Ed_Exp", 
  "SchLead_Exp", "Teaching_Exp", "move_field", "move_field_count", "move_geo", 
  "move_geo_count", "move_org", "move_org_count", "role_length", "yrs_obs", 
  "Ed_Field_Transition", "move_field_flag", "move_geo_flag", "move_org_flag",
  "Role_Field", "Leader_Role_Label", "EverRole2_4", "start_salary", 
  "additional_compensation", "total_compensation", "end_salary", "salary", 
  "location_raw", "Metro_area", "city", "country", "msa", "position_number", 
  "region", "seniority", "state", "company_cleaned", 
  "title_translated", "soc_cleaned", "company_cleaned_is_ed_org_match", 
  "company_cleaned_match_trigger", "open_ended_role_flag", 
  "overlap_capped_flag"
)

full_files <- open_dataset(
  sample_files,
  format = "parquet"
)

dt <- full_files %>%
  select(any_of(read_pos_cols)) %>% #read in only selected variables
  filter(EverExiter %in% c(1, TRUE)) %>% #read in only ever-exiters
  collect() %>%
  as.data.table()

dt[, user_id := as.character(user_id)]
dt[, position_id := as.character(position_id)]
dt[, Leader_Role_Label := trimws(as.character(Leader_Role_Label))]
dt[Leader_Role_Label == "", Leader_Role_Label := NA_character_]
dt[, Role_Field_Label := label_role_field(Role_Field)]

```


```{r}
#generate position-specific career stage variable
dt <- dt %>% mutate(
    career_stage = case_when(
      is.na(yrs_obs) ~ NA_character_,
      yrs_obs < 5 ~ "Early career",
      yrs_obs < 15 ~ "Mid career",
      yrs_obs >= 15 ~ "Late career"
    ),
    career_stage = factor(career_stage, levels = c("Early career", "Mid career", "Late career"))
  )

#dropping leaders with impossible position data (>= 50 unique position_id values)
drop_audit <- dt[
  !is.na(position_id),
  .(n_positions = uniqueN(position_id)),
  by = user_id
][n_positions >= 50]

#reporting on observations to be dropped below
fwrite(drop_audit, file.path(output_dir, "dropped_high_position_users.csv"))

dt <- dt[!user_id %in% drop_audit$user_id]
```

```{r long to wide reshape}
setorder(dt, user_id, startdate_parsed, enddate_effective, position_id)
dt[, position_seq := seq_len(.N), by = user_id]

#defining the reshape
position_vars <- setdiff(names(dt), c("user_id"))
position_vars <- setdiff(position_vars, "position_seq")

dt_wide <- dcast(
  dt,
  user_id ~ position_seq,
  value.var = position_vars
)
```

```{r}
#saving EverExiter user IDs for merges below
keep_user_ids <- unique(dt$user_id)
keep_users_dt <- data.table(user_id = keep_user_ids)
keep_users_tbl <- tibble(
  user_id = as.character(keep_users_dt$user_id)
)
```

```{r education data}
read_ed_cols <- c(
  "user_id", "university_name", "education_number", "degree", "field", 
  "startdate", "enddate"
)

education_ds <- open_dataset(
  education_files,
  format = "parquet"
)

#checking education_ds 
colnames_df_ed <- tibble(
  column_name = colnames(education_ds)
)
write_csv(
  colnames_df_ed,
  file.path(output_dir, "education_dataset_column_names.csv")
)

#reading in relevant rows
ed_dt <- education_ds %>%
  select(all_of(read_ed_cols)) %>%
  mutate(user_id = as.character(user_id)) %>%
  semi_join(keep_users_tbl, by = "user_id") %>%
  collect() %>%
  as.data.table()

ed_dt[, user_id := as.character(user_id)]

#ordering for reshape
setorder(ed_dt, user_id, education_number, startdate, enddate)
ed_dt[, education_seq := seq_len(.N), by = user_id]

#defining the reshape
education_vars <- setdiff(names(ed_dt), c("user_id"))
education_vars <- setdiff(education_vars, "education_seq")

#reshaping long ed data to wide at user level
ed_wide <- dcast(
  ed_dt,
  user_id ~ education_seq,
  value.var = education_vars
)
```

```{r merging}
analytic_dt <- merge(
  dt_wide,
  ed_wide,
  by = "user_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

analytic_dt <- merge(
  analytic_dt,
  user_dt,
  by = "user_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)
```

```{r collapsing reshaped data for non-varying variables}

#pattern generated in reshape 
suffixed_cols <- names(analytic_dt)[str_detect(names(analytic_dt), "_\\d+$")]

suffix_lookup <- tibble(
  col = suffixed_cols,
  stem = str_remove(suffixed_cols, "_\\d+$"),
  suffix_num = as.integer(str_extract(suffixed_cols, "\\d+$"))
) %>%
  arrange(stem, suffix_num)

stems_to_check <- suffix_lookup %>%
  count(stem, name = "n_cols") %>%
  filter(n_cols > 1) %>%
  pull(stem)

#holders as variable sets are checked
collapsed_stems <- c()
skipped_stems <- c()

row_matches_strict_pattern <- function(x) {
   if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(TRUE)
  } # all missing collapses 

  if (is.na(x[1])) {
    return(FALSE)
  }   # _1 must be observed if any value is observed

  last_non_missing <- max(which(!is.na(x)))   # Find last non-missing value

  if (any(is.na(x[1:last_non_missing]))) {
    return(FALSE)
  }  # All values up to last non-missing must be observed

  if (!all(x[1:last_non_missing] == x[1])) {
    return(FALSE)
  }   # All observed values must match _1

  TRUE
}   # Anything after last observed can be missing and is ignored

for (this_stem in stems_to_check) {

  stem_cols <- suffix_lookup %>%
    filter(stem == this_stem) %>%
    arrange(suffix_num) %>%
    pull(col)

  stem_matrix <- analytic_dt[, ..stem_cols]

  row_ok <- apply(
    stem_matrix,
    1,
    row_matches_strict_pattern
  )

  if (all(row_ok)) {

    keep_col <- paste0(this_stem, "_1")

    analytic_dt <- analytic_dt %>%
      mutate(!!this_stem := .data[[keep_col]]) %>%
      select(-all_of(stem_cols))

    collapsed_stems <- c(collapsed_stems, this_stem)

  } else {
    skipped_stems <- c(skipped_stems, this_stem)
  }
}

#reporting
collapsed_summary <- tibble(collapsed_stem = collapsed_stems)
skipped_summary <- tibble(skipped_stem = skipped_stems)

message("Collapsed stems: ", paste(collapsed_stems, collapse = ", "))
message("Skipped stems with conflicting within-row values: ", paste(skipped_stems, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r generating predictors for use in exiter-only analysis}
#predictors based on value at time of exit from education
analytic_dt <- analytic_dt %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    exit_index = {
      exit_vals <- c_across(matches("^ed_field_transition_\\d+$"))
      exit_pos <- which(exit_vals == 1)
      if (length(exit_pos) == 0) NA_integer_ else exit_pos[1]
    },
    post_exit_transition = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        pos_vals <- c_across(matches("^position_id_\\d+$"))
        sum(!is.na(pos_vals) & seq_along(pos_vals) > exit_index)
      }
    },
    entrant_pre_exit = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else if (exit_index <= 1) {
        0L
      } else {
        vals <- c_across(matches("^ed_field_transition_\\d+$"))
        as.integer(any(vals[1:(exit_index - 1)] == 2, na.rm = TRUE))
      }
    }, #must separately flag entrances BEFORE the initial exit, as all post-exit returns are flagged as position-level entrances (making the ever-entrant flag 1 for ALL returners, regardless of pre-education path)
    career_stage_at_exit = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        vals <- c_across(matches("^career_stage_\\d+$"))
        as.character(vals[exit_index])
      }
    },
    ed_exp_at_exit = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        vals <- c_across(matches("^ed_exp_\\d+$"))
        as.numeric(vals[exit_index])
      }
    },
   move_org_count_at_exit = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        vals <- c_across(matches("^move_org_count_\\d+$"))
        as.numeric(vals[exit_index])
      }
    },
    year_of_exit = {
      if (is.na(exit_index)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        vals <- c_across(matches("^enddate_effective_\\d+$"))
        end_val <- vals[exit_index]
        if (is.na(end_val)) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          lubridate::year(as.Date(end_val))
        }
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#BA in Education flag
analytic_dt <- analytic_dt %>%
  mutate(
    education_ba = if_else(
      if_any(matches("^field_\\d+$"), ~ !is.na(.) & stringr::str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(.))) == "education"),
      "Education BA",
      "Not education BA"
    ),
    education_ba = factor(
      education_ba,
      levels = c("Not education BA", "Education BA")
    )
  )

analytic_dt %>%
  count(education_ba)
```

```{r summarize}
analytic_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Number of unique user_id values in analytic_dt",
    "Validation: Number of Exiters in analytic_dt",
    "Number of user_ids in analytic_dt for whom Returner == 1",
    "Number of unique position_id values in analytic_dt",
    "Number of position_ids for which date_calc_valid_flag == 1",
    "Number of position_ids for which date_calc_valid_flag == 0"
  ),
  value = c(
    n_distinct(analytic_dt$user_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_users_any_wide(analytic_dt, "EverExiter", c(1, TRUE, "1", "TRUE")),
    count_users_any_wide(analytic_dt, "Returner", c(1, TRUE, "1", "TRUE")),
    count_unique_wide(analytic_dt, "position_id"),
    count_value_wide(analytic_dt, "date_calc_valid_flag", c(1, TRUE, "1", "TRUE")),
    count_value_wide(analytic_dt, "date_calc_valid_flag", c(0, FALSE, "0", "FALSE"))
  )
)

analytic_summary
```
